name: Cairn 2e
description: Character creation for Cairn, a second edition fantasy roleplaying game of wild lands and dark forests.

text: Roll 3d6 for Strength, Dexterity, and Willpower. You may swap the scores of two of the three attributes.
You have ten inventory slots. Carrying a backpack adds six more.
Bulky items take two inventory slots.
Petty items take no inventory slots.
The youngest character reads the Omens table aloud to the group.
